The Associate In Science (AS) degree is designed to provide a solid
foundation in mathematics and the sciences for cadets interested in
pursuing a four-year or advanced degree in Mathematics, Sciences,
Engineering, Pre-medical/Dental/Veterinarian, or related fields. The
following are the AS core course requirements:
ENGL 1110 (required with a grade of "C" or better), a second English
course and a third communications course.
